question.prompt: \(AB\) is a chord of \(\odot O\). Points \(C\) and \(D\) lie on major arc \(AB\), and \(\angle ACB=32^\circ\). Find the measures of \(\angle ADB\) and \(\angle AOB\) in degrees (answer in this order, separated by a comma).

solutions.explanation: Inscribed angles subtending the same arc are equal, so \(\angle ADB=\angle ACB=32^\circ\). The central angle is \(2\) times the inscribed angle, so \(\angle AOB=64^\circ\).
solutions.title: Angles subtending the same arc
